title: Patch: loading and empty states that keep the screen's frame and use the shared Skeleton and EmptyState
thread:
**Issue #3228 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3228: Patch: loading and empty states that keep the screen's frame and use the shared Skeleton and EmptyState Opened by @squishy-squooby. ### What it does Most menus already draw `skeleton/Skeleton.tsx` (R2115000) while a read waits and `empty/EmptyState.tsx` when it comes back empty: 29 files use Skeleton and 11 use EmptyState. A few do not, and one wait changes the whole screen around it. - **The decks route's loading shell** (`routes/decks.tsx:80`) is a non-`.tavern` page. Its `h1` is "JackiOh — decks", and it has no gear (`showSettings={settings}`). When the decks land, the workshop replaces it with a different background, a different bar and a different title, so the bar's look and contents jump. - `auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx:110` shows a bare `

Loading…

`. - `auth/TwoStepSettings.tsx:161` shows a bare "Checking…". - `game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.tsx:222` shows "No decks yet" as a `ws-hint` paragraph instead of `EmptyState`. Change: - The decks loading state draws the workshop's own frame (the same top bar from #3218, the same `PageTitle` from #3223, the same background) with a Skeleton in the body, so only the body changes when the decks land. - LinkedAccounts and TwoStepSettings wait with Skeleton (its `rows` or `panel` shape), keeping their sentence as the visually hidden `role="status"` line, as the README describes. - The workshop's no-decks case uses `EmptyState`, with its "New deck" action, and keeps its testid. - Look for any other bare "Loading…" or "No … yet" text in a menu (`grep -rn "Loading…\|No .* yet" apps/web/src --include=*.tsx`). Move it too, or add it to the list of still text in the README (the R2115000 paragraph) with its reason. ### Acceptance - A test renders `/decks` before and after its read lands and asserts the same top bar (Back left, gear right) and the same `h1` text in both. - LinkedAccounts and TwoStepSettings render a Skeleton while waiting, and their status text stays available to assistive tech. - The workshop with no decks renders `EmptyState`. - The R2108000 delay (`SKELETON_DELAY_MS`) still applies, so a fast read flashes nothing. - The web tests and e2e specs `46` and `47` pass. ### Blocked by, part of Blocked by #3218, #3223 ```
